Top-Rated Berkeley Plumbers (Sorted by Rating/Reviews)

| Plumber | Rating | Reviews | Key Specialties |
|---|---|---|---|
| LemonTree Plumbing | 5.0 | ~30 | Water heaters, pipes, faucet replacement |
| Afterglow Heating & Plumbing | 5.0 | 86 | Radiant heat, boilers, water heaters |
| Lifesaver Plumbing & Rooter | 5.0 | 148 | Drain cleaning, sewer replacement, pipe repair |
| J J Rooter & Plumbing | 4.9 | 94 | Sewer clogs, drain cleaning, repiping |
| L.J. Kruse Company | 4.9 | 305 | Residential/commercial heating & plumbing |
| Albert Nahman Plumbing | 4.7 | 3377 | 24/7 service, tankless water heaters |

- **Best for Complex/Large Projects (L.J. Kruse):** A long-standing family business (since 1916) trusted for major repairs and commercial work.[[1]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSGxIZCgNwdnESEkNnc3ZaeTh4ZEdzMlgzRjNkQRgK)[[2]](https://www.facebook.com/L.J.KruseCo/)[[3]](https://ljkruse.com/areas-served/san-leandro/)[[4]](https://downtobid.com/contractors/hvac/oakland)[[5]](https://ljkruse.com/areas-served/walnut-creek/)
- **Best Emergency/Quick Response (Albert Nahman):** Known for 24/7 availability and handling urgent leaks in older Berkeley homes.[[1]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSGxIZCgNwdnESEkNnc3ZaeTh4ZEdSd1oyWXlZZxgK)[[2]](https://albertnahmanplumbing.com/commercial/plumbing/)
- **Best for Sewer & Drain (J J Rooter & Pipe Spy):** Specialists in sewer lateral replacements and root removal.[[1]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSHRIbCgNwdnESFENnMHZaeTh4TVdwMk0yZzFiWGQ0GAo)

- **License Check:** Always verify a plumber's license through the [CA CSLB](https://www.cslb.ca.gov/) to ensure they can legally pull permits in Berkeley.
